title: This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below 2^{-38} (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the degree-6 Taylor sum of `exp(361)` equals `2250616516186117/720`, which is strictly greater than `2^{38}*(319/100) = 21921513078784/25`.
- The next Taylor term is positive, so `(319/100) exp(-361) < 2^{-38}`. This section's polynomial-inverse error is strictly below that majorant, hence strictly below `2^{-38}`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is the case `C=2` on one normalized section, and `Q` is not formed.
